sheet.title: Print Standard Answer Sheet
sheet.subtitle: Download A4 PDF format to print and distribute to students
instructions: Print at 100% scale (Actual Size) on standard A4 paper. Do not select 'Fit to Page'.
Ensure all 4 black corner alignment markers are printed completely and clearly.
Students must fill bubbles firmly using a 2B pencil or dark black/blue pen.
Students must bubble-encode their 8-digit Student ID in the designated grid.
